mapper.select: SELECT ASSET_ID, NAME, CATEGORY, COMPANY, STATUS, IMAGE, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, USAGE_TIME, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IS_DELETED FROM ASSET WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT START_TIME AS START_AT, END_TIME AS END_AT FROM RESERVATION r INNER JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE a.NAME = (SELECT NAME FROM ASSET WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AND a.CATEGORY = (SELECT CATEGORY FROM ASSET WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AND a.COMPANY = (SELECT COMPANY FROM ASSET WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AND a.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME >= #{from} AND r.START_TIME <= #{to} ORDER BY r.START_TIME

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND ( (START_TIME <= #{startAt} AND END_TIME > #{startAt}) OR (START_TIME < #{endAt} AND END_TIME >= #{endAt}) OR (START_TIME >= #{startAt} AND END_TIME <= #{endAt}) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NAME = #{name} AND (CATEGORY = #{category} OR (CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (COMPANY = #{company} OR (COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL)) AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'

SELECT ASSET_ID, NAME, CATEGORY, COMPANY, STATUS, IMAGE, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, USAGE_TIME, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IS_DELETED FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NAME = #{name} AND (CATEGORY = #{category} OR (CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (COMPANY = #{company} OR (COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL)) AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' FOR UPDATE WAIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NAME = #{name} AND (CATEGORY = #{category} OR (CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (COMPANY = #{company} OR (COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL)) AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION ( ASSET_ID, USER_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, PURPOSE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_STATE, ADDRESS_CITY, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{assetId}, #{userId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{purpose}, #{address}, #{addressState}, #{addressCity}, #{status} )
